add_library_template.description: Copy a ready-made template from Bannerbear's library into your workspace, ready to use with 'Create image' or 'Create animation'. Trial workspaces hold up to 3 of each kind.
add_library_template.display_str_template: Add template from library in Bannerbear.
add_library_template.name: add_library_template

parameters.description: The template's id, from 'Search template library'.
parameters.name: library_template

kind.description: What was added: image, animation or workflow

template.description: The new template in your workspace (an animation template also has a frame rate and duration)

apply_animation_preset.description: Give an animation template's layers a ready-made movement, such as fading or zooming in, one after another if you like. Free; Bannerbear keeps the previous version.
apply_animation_preset.display_str_template: Animate template with a preset in Bannerbear.
apply_animation_preset.name: apply_animation_preset

parameters.description: The animation template. Pick one, or give its id from an earlier step.
parameters.name: template

parameters.description: The movement to give each layer.
parameters.name: preset

parameters.description: The layers to animate, in the order they should start. Leave empty for every layer.
parameters.name: layers

parameters.description: How long each layer's movement takes, in milliseconds. Defaults to 400.
parameters.name: duration

parameters.description: Milliseconds between one layer starting and the next. Defaults to 0, all at once.
parameters.name: stagger

parameters.description: Yes: only the chosen layers change. No (default): the template's whole timeline is replaced.
parameters.name: keep_other_animations

template.description: The template with its new timeline

create_animation.description: Make a video from an animation template, with your text and pictures in its layers. Waits for it to finish (usually under a minute) and returns the MP4's URL. Uses 2 credits per second.
create_animation.name: create_animation

parameters.description: The animation template. Pick one, or give its id from an earlier step.
parameters.name: template

parameters.description: What to put in each layer: text for a text layer, an image URL for an image layer. Leave a layer empty to keep the template's own.
parameters.name: layer_values

parameters.description: Anything else to change on a layer, in Bannerbear's format: a list of objects naming the layer, like [{"name": "title", "color": "#FF0000"}] or [{"name": "badge", "hidden": true}].
parameters.name: layer_changes

parameters.description: Defaults to the template's own, usually 30 fps.
parameters.name: frame_rate

parameters.description: Leave out the background. The video is then a MOV file.
parameters.name: transparent

parameters.description: Your own note to keep with the result, such as an order number.
parameters.name: metadata

create_image.description: Make an image from a template, with your text and pictures in its layers. Waits for it to finish and returns the file's URL. Uses 1 credit per file type and size step.
create_image.name: create_image

parameters.description: The image template. Pick one, or give its id from an earlier step.
parameters.name: template

parameters.description: What to put in each layer: text for a text layer, an image URL for an image layer. Leave a layer empty to keep the template's own.
parameters.name: layer_values

parameters.description: Anything else to change on a layer, in Bannerbear's format: a list of objects naming the layer, like [{"name": "title", "color": "#FF0000"}] or [{"name": "badge", "hidden": true}].
parameters.name: layer_changes

parameters.description: The files to make. Defaults to JPG. Each extra type uses another credit.
parameters.name: formats

parameters.description: Render larger than the template, for sharper images. Each step up multiplies the credits used.
parameters.name: scale

parameters.description: Leave out the template's background. Use with PNG or WebP.
parameters.name: transparent

parameters.description: Your own note to keep with the result, such as an order number.
parameters.name: metadata

create_pdf.description: Put JPG, PNG and PDF files together into one PDF, a page each, in the order given. Returns the PDF's URL. Uses 1 credit.
create_pdf.name: create_pdf

parameters.description: The URLs of the JPG, PNG or PDF files, in page order.
parameters.name: urls

parameters.description: Your own note to keep with the result, such as an order number.
parameters.name: metadata

delete_animation_template.description: Delete an animation template from the workspace. Videos already made from it are kept.
delete_animation_template.name: delete_animation_template

parameters.description: The animation template. Pick one, or give its id from an earlier step.
parameters.name: template

delete_image_template.description: Delete an image template from the workspace. Images already made from it are kept.
delete_image_template.name: delete_image_template

parameters.description: The image template. Pick one, or give its id from an earlier step.
parameters.name: template

generate_ai_image.description: Make an image from a written description with an AI model. Returns the image's URL. Uses AI credits, fewest with Flux Schnell.
generate_ai_image.name: generate_ai_image

parameters.description: What to make: the subject, style and composition, up to 2,000 characters.

examples.label: A description
examples.value: A red bicycle against a white wall, soft light

parameters.name: prompt

parameters.description: The AI model. Defaults to Flux Schnell.
parameters.name: model

parameters.description: The image's shape. Defaults to square.
parameters.name: aspect_ratio

parameters.description: An image to start from. Only some models use one.
parameters.name: reference_image_url

parameters.description: Your own note to keep with the result, such as an order number.
parameters.name: metadata

get_account.description: Get the connected Bannerbear workspace: its plan, and how many credits and AI credits it has used and has left this month.
get_account.name: get_account

get_animation.description: Get one animation with its progress and video URL.
get_animation.name: get_animation

parameters.description: The animation's id, from 'Create animation'.
parameters.name: animation_id

get_image.description: Get one image with its status and file URLs.
get_image.name: get_image

parameters.description: The image's id, from 'Create image' or 'List images'.
parameters.name: image_id

get_image_template.description: Get one image template: its name, size, preview and the name and type of each layer you can fill in.
get_image_template.name: get_image_template

parameters.description: The image template. Pick one, or give its id from an earlier step.
parameters.name: template

get_workflow_run.description: Get one workflow run: its status, progress, each step's result, and any error.
get_workflow_run.name: get_workflow_run

parameters.description: The run's id, from 'Run workflow'.
parameters.name: run_id

outputs.description: Each step's results by step name, such as its file URLs

list_animation_templates.description: List the workspace's animation templates with their length, size and layers. Returns 25 at a time.
list_animation_templates.name: list_animation_templates

parameters.description: Which page of 25 to get, newest first. Defaults to the first.
parameters.name: page

next_page.description: The next page's number, or empty on the last page

list_image_templates.description: List the workspace's image templates with their sizes, previews and layers. Returns 25 at a time.
list_image_templates.name: list_image_templates

parameters.description: Which page of 25 to get, newest first. Defaults to the first.
parameters.name: page

next_page.description: The next page's number, or empty on the last page

list_images.description: List the workspace's images, newest first, with their status and file URLs. Returns 25 at a time.
list_images.name: list_images

parameters.description: Which page of 25 to get, newest first. Defaults to the first.
parameters.name: page

next_page.description: The next page's number, or empty on the last page

remove_background.description: Cut the subject of a photo out onto a transparent background. Returns the PNG's URL. Uses 2 credits and 1 AI credit.
remove_background.name: remove_background

parameters.description: The URL of a JPG or PNG photo.
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.description: Your own note to keep with the result, such as an order number.
parameters.name: metadata

run_workflow.description: Start one of your Bannerbear workflows with its inputs, wait for it to finish, and return each step's results. Uses the credits its steps use.
run_workflow.name: run_workflow

parameters.description: The Bannerbear workflow. Pick one, or give its id from an earlier step.
parameters.name: workflow

parameters.description: A value for each of the workflow's inputs.
parameters.name: inputs

parameters.description: Yes (default): the step returns the results, waiting up to 10 minutes. No: it returns as soon as the run starts.
parameters.name: wait

parameters.description: Your own note to keep with the result, such as an order number.
parameters.name: metadata

outputs.description: Each step's results by step name, such as its file URLs

search_template_library.description: Search Bannerbear's library of ready-made templates by name, kind and category. Add one to your workspace with 'Add template from library'.

templates.description: A modern header for tech brands.
templates.name: Violet Modern Tech Twitter / X Header

search_template_library.name: search_template_library

parameters.description: Words in the template's name, like Instagram story.
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: Image or animation templates. Leave empty for both.
parameters.name: template_type

parameters.description: Only templates in this category.
parameters.name: category

parameters.description: Which page of 25 to get, newest first. Defaults to the first.
parameters.name: page

next_page.description: The next page's number, or empty on the last page

update_image_template.description: Change an image template's name, description or tags. Only the fields given change; new tags replace the old ones.
update_image_template.display_str_template: Rename or tag image template in Bannerbear.
update_image_template.name: update_image_template

parameters.description: The image template. Pick one, or give its id from an earlier step.
parameters.name: template

parameters.description: A new name. Leave empty to keep it.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: A new description. Leave empty to keep it.
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: Tags to set, replacing the current ones. Leave empty to keep them.
parameters.name: tags

description: Make images and videos from your Bannerbear templates, combine files into PDFs, remove backgrounds, generate AI images and run Bannerbear workflows.

bannerbear_new_image_trigger.description: Runs when an image finishes rendering in Bannerbear, however it was made. Optionally only for one template.

output.files: Every file made, by type (jpg, png and so on).
output.metadata: The note it was made with, if any.
output.template: The ID of the template it was made from.

parameters.description: Only run for images made from this template. Leave blank to run for every image.
parameters.name: template_id

bannerbear_workflow_run_finished_trigger.description: Runs when a Bannerbear workflow run completes or fails. Optionally only for one workflow.

output.error: Why it failed, when it did.
output.inputs: The inputs it was started with.
output.metadata: The note it was started with, if any.
output.outputs: Each step's results by step name, such as file URLs.
output.workflow: The ID of the Bannerbear workflow that ran.

parameters.description: Only run when this Bannerbear workflow finishes. Leave blank to run for every workflow.
parameters.name: workflow_id
